text: Decentralized governance models such as DAOs answer the criticism that micro level quantum properties do not scale to the macro level, because DAOs demonstrate participatory governance structures that operate effectively in large, complex economies.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Quantum Economy and Tokenomics (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4900878
abstract: Additionally, the use of decentralized governance models in tokenomics, such as DAOs, can address the criticism that quantum properties observed at the micro level do not scale up to the macro level.

value: large scale decentralized economies with DAO governance
